implementation_contract.rule: Project-level goal.start retains null session/revision/epoch, required real project ID, and exact existing payload fields. Only a successful typed Goal result may establish the CLI session.

Result goal_id must be nonempty, goal_revision positive integer, goal_status in frozen enum, and nested SessionSnapshot project/goal/session/protocol/build/revision valid. Any non-null envelope session_id must equal snapshot.session_id. Explicitly selected session cannot be replaced. No mutation of saved context until these checks succeed.

Adopt returned session revision independently of goal_revision. Adopt writer epoch only from the returned snapshot when writer.client_id equals current client, and do not retain a stale prior writer epoch for a newly adopted session. No takeover or automatic grant escalation.

Existing-session goal first performs a real session.get, captures its event cursor and valid revision/epoch, then calls goal.start. Project-level no-session path follows from cursor0 in the real returned session; old events cannot settle the target because Goal->unique Task->Run identity remains authoritative.

For start_as_draft=true, require returned DRAFT state and report GOAL_DRAFT_CREATED with execution NOT_STARTED and independent_acceptance NOT_EVALUATED. Exit0 here denotes the explicitly requested draft establishment only; do not invoke session.send, follow/dispatch a Run, or present EXECUTION_REPORTED/ACCEPTED.

For non-draft, method ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED cannot mean finished execution. Await the exact method result, bind returned Goal/snapshot, then reuse S1 follower and canonical Task/Run/report/artifact/event gates. BLOCKED/unavailable/no qualified execution returns3, failed execution1, confirmed cancellation130, and only complete reported execution0. Return DRAFT for a non-draft request is unresolved/blocked, not success.

Set admission_command_id for goal.start, preserve cancellation intent during pending method result and null Run binding, and use the same host CANCEL settlement path after the original Task obtains its Run. A signal before first Goal write prevents that write; a signal after dispatch never permits a new Goal ID/envelope to replace the pending one.

Persist only validated actual Goal-session context after blocked or interrupted outcomes so resume/status can identify it. Goal and Session revisions remain distinct. Keep same problem/candidate/input lineage entirely under host authority; CLI must not manufacture or reset it.

required_independent_review_guards: Validate the complete typed Goal result before mutating persistent CLI context. In particular, result.goal_status must equal nested snapshot.goal_status as well as the frozen enum; result.goal_id must equal snapshot.goal_id; both project and explicit session identity must match. A result with no real non-null snapshot identity is rejected.

v2CallTransport currently calls adoptV2Snapshot on a temporary attempt and cliFlow.call later adopts the shared context. The Goal-specific validation must gate the shared-context adoption and saved config; a malformed COMPLETED result cannot establish a session or retain an old writer epoch.

For a newly adopted Session, use snapshot.revision for writer CAS and Goal result.goal_revision only as canonical Goal metadata. Adopt writer.epoch only when snapshot.writer.client_id is this CLI client; an old epoch cannot carry into the new Session.

For an existing Session, read session.get first, capture the pre-admission event cursor and current writer CAS, then issue exactly one original goal.start envelope. Pending ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS replay must keep that envelope byte-identical.

An explicitly requested draft may report Goal establishment only when Goal and snapshot both say DRAFT, without execution polling or independent acceptance. A non-draft DRAFT or BLOCKED admission cannot exit zero as completed execution.

Set the original goal.start admission command identity and preserve signal intent before a Run exists. Interrupt before first write prevents the write; after dispatch, only the original Goal Task and Run may be followed or cancelled. Exit 130 requires host-confirmed cancellation.

A non-draft Goal may exit zero only after the S1 canonical Run/report/artifact/event settlement gates. No Goal method COMPLETED response, one-page event read, or accepted Goal status alone substitutes for that proof.

Keep JSONL stdout and existing context-resume behavior. Test goal, go and interactive /goal; cover no-session adoption, existing-session CAS, differing Goal/Session revisions, draft, pending replay, blocked/failed/incomplete/cancelled outcomes, malformed identities and stale epoch. Retain S1 regression evidence separately.

required_tests.case: No-session project Goal request carries null CAS; validated host Goal snapshot adopts real session and writer epoch, then follows events and settles target execution. No session.create/session.send is emitted as a substitute.
Existing session Goal first refreshes via session.get and uses its exact CAS/cursor. Typed reply cannot replace explicit session or project; mismatch leaves saved context unchanged.
goal_revision differs from snapshot revision (both valid); CLI uses snapshot revision for subsequent controls, and never treats Goal revision as writer CAS.
Draft returns typed DRAFT establishment without execution polling/admission; no claim of Run settlement or independent acceptance. Non-draft returning DRAFT does not exit0.
ACKNOWLEDGED then IN_PROGRESS then COMPLETED Goal response uses byte-identical replay envelope; event follower waits for original Task Run and refuses old terminal events.
Non-draft Goal with BLOCKED Task returns3; failed Run returns1; incomplete report/artifacts/children/queue returns3 rather than successful Goal method completion.

Interrupt after goal.start admission with null Run retains intent, later cancels original Run and requires confirmation for130. Unconfirmed/no Run remains3 with Goal/session/admission command identity.
Invalid Goal id/status/revision, nested goal/project/session mismatch, wrong writer, or missing snapshot refuses before adoption. No stale epoch leaks from prior context.
goal, go and interactive /goal share the same Goal establishment/follow path; stdout remains JSONL and new-session context persists for resume/status.
Retain all source-current S1 CLI event/cancel, native first-use and continuation tests, with locked Go1.27.1 and exact raw/input evidence. Do not rewrite old evidence into new source-current PASS.
